### Avg Weekly Hours (Manufacturing) [...] Consumer spending power. Adjusted for seasonal patterns but not inflation.

### 10Y-2Y Treasury Spread

Positive = normal yield curve. Negative (inversion) historically precedes recessions by 6–18 months.

### University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment

Higher is better. Below 60 signals pessimism; above 80 signals optimism.

### Unemployment Rate

Lower is better. Rising unemployment signals economic weakness.

### Philly Fed Coincident Index [...] ### Real GDP

The broadest measure of economic output. Two consecutive quarterly declines = technical recession.

### Housing Starts

Forward-looking construction activity. Volatile month-to-month; trend matters more.

### Initial Jobless Claims

Lower is better. Spikes indicate sudden layoffs; a leading labor indicator.

### Industrial Production Index

Broad measure of factory, mining, and utility output. Declining trend signals contraction.

### JOLTS Job Openings
